title: Nasty Juice Devil Teeth 50/50 10ml E-Liquid
description: Devil Teeth by Nasty Juice is an e-juice formulated to whisk you away to tropical climes thanks to the fresh, luscious sweetness of Cantaloupe and Honeydew Melon blended with a subtle yet refreshing layer of cool Mint. This e-liquid from Nasty Juice offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing immaculate flavour and rich, satisfying clouds. This e-liquid is versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits .
